enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow under head. Stretch legs. Yawn. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and yogurt. Close refrigerator. Take bowl from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Add milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Put bowl in sink. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Exit bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Open bag. Take out transit card. Put card in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Greet patients. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records on computer. Consult with doctor. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch. Check patient vital signs again. Administer medication. Clean medical equipment. Talk to patient: 'How are you feeling?' Write notes. Prepare for next day. Clock out. Leave workplace.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop ingredients. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables and chicken. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Put plate in sink. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put dishes away.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check email. Close laptop. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Exit living room.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
